verses.text: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
lines: Praise Yah,
for it is good to sing praises to our God;
for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

verses.text: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
lines: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem.
He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

verses.text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
lines: He heals the broken in heart,
and binds up their wounds.

verses.text: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
lines: He counts the number of the stars.
He calls them all by their names.

verses.text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
lines: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power.
His understanding is infinite.

verses.text: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
lines: Yahweh upholds the humble.
He brings the wicked down to the ground.

verses.text: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
lines: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving.
Sing praises on the harp to our God,

verses.text: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
lines: who covers the sky with clouds,
who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass grow on the mountains.

verses.text: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
lines: He provides food for the livestock,
and for the young ravens when they call.

verses.text: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
lines: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse.
He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.text: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
lines: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him,
in those who hope in his loving kindness.

verses.text: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
lines: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem!
Praise your God, Zion!

verses.text: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
lines: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates.
He has blessed your children within you.

verses.text: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
lines: He makes peace in your borders.
He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

verses.text: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
lines: He sends out his commandment to the earth.
His word runs very swiftly.

verses.text: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
lines: He gives snow like wool,
and scatters frost like ashes.

verses.text: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
lines: He hurls down his hail like pebbles.
Who can stand before his cold?

verses.text: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
lines: He sends out his word, and melts them.
He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

verses.text: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
lines: He shows his word to Jacob,
his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

verses.text: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
lines: He has not done this for just any nation.
They don’t know his ordinances.
Praise Yah!
